threshold_derivation.derivation_method: Conservative maximum of (1) 3-sigma theoretical two-date speckle noise from Stage-2 ENL, (2) 3 * robust MAD sigma across N=218,705 stable consolidated desert pixels (12-day and 4-month span), and (3) 99th percentile of |delta_dB| over stable desert pixels.

story_mode_focal_rois.title: Eastern Oasis Summer Crop Peak & September Harvest (Sennuris / Tamia)
story_mode_focal_rois.change_type: Change Type A1 — Agricultural Phenology & Harvest
story_mode_focal_rois.small_sample_disclosure: Temporal sample size N=10 dates (12-day repeat from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21); spatial patch size N=25 filtered 40m pixels (400 native 10m pixels = 4.0 ha).
story_mode_focal_rois.observation_statement: OBSERVATION: Cross-polarized HV gamma0 rises from -19.43 dB (2026-06-23) to a peak of -8.66 dB (2026-08-10), then drops to -20.28 dB (2026-09-27) and -19.89 dB (2026-10-21). Co-polarized HH gamma0 rises from -12.98 dB to -6.58 dB, then drops to -13.93 dB.
story_mode_focal_rois.change_detection_statement: CHANGE DETECTION: Early-to-Peak Summer log-ratio change is +10.77 dB in HV (5.3x tau_HV = 2.03 dB) and +6.40 dB in HH (2.3x tau_HH = 2.73 dB). Peak-to-Autumn log-ratio change is -11.23 dB in HV (-11.62 dB to Sept 27 trough) and -5.41 dB in HH.
story_mode_focal_rois.hypothesis_statement: INTERPRETATION (hypothesis): Vigorous summer maize/sorghum/cotton vegetative stem-and-leaf volume accumulation peaking in mid-August (confirmed by concurrent Sentinel-2 NDVI peak of 0.779 on 2026-08-10), followed by complete mechanical harvest and stalk clearance by late September (Sentinel-2 NDVI trough of 0.154 on 2026-09-26).
story_mode_focal_rois.confounder_note: Notice on 2026-10-19/21: Sentinel-2 optical NDVI rebounds to 0.661 due to thin winter-crop seedling leaf chlorophyll covering the soil, whereas 24 cm L-band HV remains low (-19.89 dB) because small seedlings lack woody stem/canopy volume comparable to the 24 cm radar wavelength.

story_mode_focal_rois.title: Northeastern Basin Late-Summer Planting & Autumn Canopy Closure
story_mode_focal_rois.change_type: Change Type A1 — Asynchronous Multi-Cropping Phenology
story_mode_focal_rois.small_sample_disclosure: Temporal sample size N=10 dates (12-day repeat from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21); spatial patch size N=25 filtered 40m pixels (400 native 10m pixels = 4.0 ha).
story_mode_focal_rois.observation_statement: OBSERVATION: HV gamma0 starts near the bare-soil noise floor at -22.97 dB (2026-06-23) and -22.95 dB (2026-07-05), then increases monotonically across 8 consecutive passes to -11.43 dB (2026-10-21). HH gamma0 increases from -17.20 dB to -1.76 dB over the same period.
story_mode_focal_rois.change_detection_statement: CHANGE DETECTION: Full 4-month log-ratio increase of +11.54 dB in HV (5.7x tau_HV) and +15.44 dB in HH (5.7x tau_HH), classified in Regime 1 (Canopy Volume Growth + Double-Bounce).
story_mode_focal_rois.hypothesis_statement: INTERPRETATION (hypothesis): Fallow/bare prepared parcel in June-July transitioning into dense late-summer/autumn irrigated row crop with strong stem-ground double-bounce (HH = -1.76 dB) and dense depolarizing canopy volume (HV = -11.43 dB) by October.
story_mode_focal_rois.confounder_note: Strong HH surge (+15.44 dB) reflects both canopy volume and vertical stem-water/wet-soil dihedral double-bounce along row orientation relative to the Ascending look azimuth.

story_mode_focal_rois.title: Southern Fayoum Seasonal Basin Drawdown & Re-Inundation
story_mode_focal_rois.change_type: Change Type A2 — Hydrological Drawdown & Flood Irrigation Cycle
story_mode_focal_rois.small_sample_disclosure: Temporal sample size N=10 dates (12-day repeat from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21); spatial patch size N=25 filtered 40m pixels (400 native 10m pixels = 4.0 ha).
story_mode_focal_rois.observation_statement: OBSERVATION: HH gamma0 starts low at -16.48 dB (2026-06-23), surges to -4.92 dB on 2026-08-10, drops sharply to -13.26 dB on 2026-09-27, and rebounds to -7.99 dB on 2026-10-09. HV remains low throughout (-21.90 dB to -16.29 dB).
story_mode_focal_rois.change_detection_statement: CHANGE DETECTION: Early-to-Peak Summer HH jumps by +11.56 dB (>4.2x tau_HH) while HV changes by +3.69 dB; between Aug 10 and Sept 27, HH plunges by -8.34 dB while HV stays below -18 dB.
story_mode_focal_rois.hypothesis_statement: INTERPRETATION (hypothesis): Specular standing water in June (-16.48 dB HH) drains/evaporates to expose rough wet bare soil/mudflats in August (-4.92 dB HH), is re-flooded with specular water on September 27 (-13.26 dB HH), and drains again in October (-7.99 dB HH).
story_mode_focal_rois.confounder_note: In L-band SAR, standing water acts as a mirror (specular reflection away from sensor -> low HH), whereas wet rough unflooded soil produces high Bragg/surface backscatter (+HH). Thus, flooding causes a sharp HH decrease, while wetting of bare rough soil causes an HH increase.

story_mode_focal_rois.title: Southeastern Oasis Polarization Disagreement (+HH Surge vs -HV Loss)
story_mode_focal_rois.small_sample_disclosure: Temporal sample size N=10 dates (12-day repeat from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21); spatial patch size N=25 filtered 40m pixels (400 native 10m pixels = 4.0 ha).
story_mode_focal_rois.observation_statement: OBSERVATION: Between 2026-08-10 and 2026-10-09/21, HV gamma0 decreases from -14.32 dB to -16.92 dB (-16.70 dB on Oct 21), while HH gamma0 simultaneously surges from -7.18 dB to +1.06 dB (+0.78 dB on Oct 21).
story_mode_focal_rois.change_detection_statement: CHANGE DETECTION: Opposite-sign dual-pol divergence between Aug 10 and Oct 09/21: delta_HH = +7.96 dB (+8.24 dB to Oct 09, exceeding +tau_HH = +2.73 dB) while delta_HV = -2.38 dB (-2.60 dB to Oct 09, exceeding -tau_HV = -2.03 dB).
story_mode_focal_rois.hypothesis_statement: INTERPRETATION (hypothesis): Crop canopy removal/harvest reduces volume depolarization (-HV), immediately followed by deep chisel plowing / ridge tillage and pre-planting flood irrigation oriented perpendicular to the radar look vector, creating intense wet-soil Bragg/dihedral co-polarized reflection (+HH).
story_mode_focal_rois.confounder_note: Single-polarization HH analysis would misclassify this +8 dB HH jump as 'growth', whereas dual-pol HH+HV resolves simultaneous canopy loss (-HV) and surface roughness/moisture increase (+HH).

story_mode_focal_rois.title: Lake Qarun Central Open-Water Station (Specular & Wind-Wave Floor)
story_mode_focal_rois.change_type: Baseline / Confounder Control — Open Water Wind-Roughness Floor
story_mode_focal_rois.small_sample_disclosure: Temporal sample size N=10 dates (12-day repeat from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21); spatial patch size N=25 filtered 40m pixels (400 native 10m pixels = 4.0 ha).
story_mode_focal_rois.observation_statement: OBSERVATION: HV gamma0 stays flat near the sensor NESZ floor across all 10 dates (-22.64 dB to -23.38 dB; 10-date range = 0.74 dB). HH gamma0 remains between -18.51 dB and -20.11 dB (10-date range = 1.60 dB).
story_mode_focal_rois.change_detection_statement: CHANGE DETECTION: All consecutive and seasonal changes remain strictly below tau_HH (2.73 dB) and tau_HV (2.03 dB): full-span delta_HH = -1.26 dB, delta_HV = -0.59 dB (Regime 0: No Significant Change).
story_mode_focal_rois.hypothesis_statement: INTERPRETATION (hypothesis): Permanent open saline lake water exhibiting specular reflection in 24 cm L-band SAR, with minor 1.6 dB HH fluctuations driven by surface capillary/short-gravity Bragg waves under varying 2m wind speeds (2.1 to 4.9 m/s in NASA POWER).
story_mode_focal_rois.confounder_note: Because calm open water operates near the -23.3 dB HH / -24.5 dB HV NESZ noise floor, small dB fluctuations over open water are thermal noise + wind-wave artifacts, not bathymetric change.

story_mode_focal_rois.title: Jebel Qatrani Eocene Limestone Plateau (Radiometric Stability Control)
story_mode_focal_rois.change_type: Baseline / Calibration Control — Stable Hyper-Arid Desert
story_mode_focal_rois.small_sample_disclosure: Temporal sample size N=10 dates (12-day repeat from 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-21); spatial patch size N=25 filtered 40m pixels (400 native 10m pixels = 4.0 ha).
story_mode_focal_rois.observation_statement: OBSERVATION: Across all 10 dates from June to October 2026, HH gamma0 stays tightly locked between -13.08 dB and -13.69 dB (10-date dynamic range = 0.61 dB), and HV gamma0 stays between -19.87 dB and -20.64 dB (10-date dynamic range = 0.77 dB).
story_mode_focal_rois.change_detection_statement: CHANGE DETECTION: Full 4-month delta_HH = +0.32 dB and delta_HV = -0.08 dB, well inside the noise thresholds (tau_HH = 2.73 dB, tau_HV = 2.03 dB; Regime 0: No Significant Change).
story_mode_focal_rois.hypothesis_statement: INTERPRETATION (hypothesis): Hyper-arid consolidated Eocene limestone desert plateau with zero precipitation (0.15 mm total in NASA POWER) and zero vegetation (Sentinel-2 NDVI ~ 0.08), confirming sub-decibel NISAR L2_GCOV radiometric stability (CRID P05023) across the 120-day series.
story_mode_focal_rois.confounder_note: Sub-decibel fluctuations (< 0.8 dB across 10 dates) represent residual speckle (Stage-2 ENL > 230) and thermal noise, validating our conservative change thresholds.

external_context_non_nisar.rule2_compliance_notice: All datasets in this section are external non-NISAR context datasets used strictly for confounder verification and independent optical cross-checking. They are explicitly labelled with their true sensor/model sources per Rule 2.

nasa_power_meteorology.source_label: NASA POWER Agroclimatology Daily API (MERRA-2 / GEOS-5.12.4) — External Non-NISAR Meteorological Context (Rule 2)
nasa_power_meteorology.scientific_implication: Total rainfall across the entire June-October 2026 window was 0.15 mm (0 days >= 0.5 mm). This confirms that soil moisture and inundation changes observed inside Fayoum Oasis agricultural fields are driven by managed Nile canal irrigation (via Bahr Youssef) rather than synoptic rainfall events, while wind speed variations (2.1 to 4.9 m/s on overpass days) modulate capillary wave Bragg roughness on open Lake Qarun water.
